name: smwblocks-crash-bandicoot-nitro-crate-block-exploding-block
title: Crash Bandicoot - "Nitro Crate" Block (Exploding Block)
description:
This block is a custom block that explode if there contact with: Mario, Sprites, Fireballs & Cape contact! When the block detects any of thoses contacts, he will erase himself, makes an particle/smoke effect and makes instantly the explosion from the Vanilla Original SMW Sprite 0D: Bob-omb.

This custom block come with some defines/options that you can change freely.

More details in the Readme file!

Requested by bandicoot
